_comment: Synthetic demo businesses. Stand-in for the finance unit and the input service until they exist; see api/src/services/advisor/NOTES.md. Money is INR, monthlyRevenue is Jan..Dec.

businesses.name: Maa Tarini Kirana Store
businesses.description: Neighbourhood grocery in a low-lying lane near the Puri market. Rice, dal, oil, packaged goods and some vegetables.

river_flood.reason: Lane floods and the shop shuts; ground-floor stock is at risk.

flash_flood.reason: Waterlogging keeps customers away for a day or two.

storm.reason: Cyclone warnings close the market and cut power.

heat.reason: Daily essentials sell regardless of heat.

drought.reason: Urban demand is not tied to the harvest.

cold_wave.reason: Cold waves are rare on this coast.

businesses.name: Sri Ganesh Bakery
businesses.description: Bakery and snacks counter with two ovens and a cold display, on a main road in Chennai.

formFacts.storage_level: ground floor, cold display on the floor
formFacts.insurance: shop policy covers fire only, not flood

flash_flood.reason: Waterlogging on the main road stops walk-in trade.

storm.reason: Power cuts spoil cold stock and stop the ovens.

heat.reason: Afternoon footfall drops and cooling costs rise.

drought.reason: City water supply is the main exposure.

businesses.name: Patil Agro Inputs
businesses.description: Seeds, fertiliser and pesticide dealer selling to farmers on credit around Latur. Sales follow the kharif and rabi sowing seasons.

formFacts.revenue_pattern: seasonal: kharif sowing Jun-Jul, rabi Oct-Nov

businesses.name: Rathore Tailoring & Alterations
businesses.description: Tailoring shop with four machines on the first floor of a market building in Jaipur. Busy in the wedding season.

formFacts.insurance: shop and stock insured, including flood
formFacts.revenue_pattern: steady, peaks in the Nov-Feb wedding season
formFacts.road_power_dependency: inverter backup for machines; shop is on a main road

heat.reason: Indoor work; some afternoon footfall is lost in May-June.

storm.reason: Dust storms close the market for a few hours.

flash_flood.reason: First-floor shop; customers stay away during heavy rain.

river_flood.reason: No river exposure at this site.

drought.reason: Urban trade is not tied to rainfall.
